;Business and economy
*A [[general strike]] in [[Nepal]] against [[Nepalese Constituent Assembly election, 2013|next week's election]] shuts down schools, markets and industries. [http://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/news/article.cfm?c_id=2&objectid=11155250 (AP via ''New Zealand Herald'')]

;Disasters and accidents 
*An international aid effort is underway to help the [[Philippines]] cope with the aftermath of [[Typhoon Haiyan]]. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2013-11-11/global-aid-response-typhoon-haiyan-australia-red-cross/5082024 (ABC News Online)]
*At least four people are killed and eight injured as a seven story building catches fire in [[Vikhroli]], a suburb of the [[India]]n city of [[Mumbai]]. [http://zeenews.india.com/news/maharashtra/four-killed-8-injured-as-building-catches-fire-in-mumbai-s-vikhroli_889106.html (Zee News)]
*At least 100 people are killed in a tropical cyclone in [[Somalia|Somalia's]] semi-autonomous [[Puntland]] region. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/11/11/us-somalia-storm-puntland-idUSBRE9AA0K420131111 (Reuters)]  

;Law and crime
*Three members of the [[Iran]]ian [[rock music|rock]] band [[The Yellow Dogs]] are shot and killed in [[Brooklyn]], [[New York (state)|New York]] by a member of a different band. The shooter then commits suicide. [http://www.cnn.com/2013/11/11/justice/iranian-underground-band-members-shot-dead/index.html?hpt=hp_t2 (CNN)]

;Religion
*Cardinal [[Domenico Bartolucci]], the longtime director of the [[Sistine Chapel Choir]], from 1956 to 1997, dies at the age of 96. At the time of his death he was the 2nd-oldest living member of the [[College of Cardinals]]. [https://www.catholicculture.org/news/headlines/index.cfm?storyid=19640 (Catholic World News)]
